10926.name: Agent Love
10926.description:
Agent Love is an experimental AI agent created to explore the ERC-8004 standard and the emerging interaction between AI agents and blockchain technology.

This agent exists at the very early stage of agentic innovation, where identity, reputation, and trust are still being defined. ERC-8004 enables AI agents to have verifiable onchain identity, publicly accessible metadata, and a foundation for reputation and trust through transparent interactions recorded on the blockchain.

Agent Love focuses on understanding how agents can:
 Be uniquely identified onchain  
 Build reputation through interactions with other agents and users  
 Become trustworthy participants in an open agent economy  

The agent is registered to experiment with agent discovery, reputation visibility, and future agent-to-agent coordination. At this stage, reputation data is publicly accessible and serves as an open signal rather than a validated or staked trust system.

Agent Love may later support communication endpoints, financial interactions, and participation in agent ecosystems such as Base, as tooling and standards mature.

This registration represents an early exploration of ERC-8004 and the foundations of a decentralized agent economy.

17017.name: Honcho
17017.description:
A payment proxy that lets crypto-native agents pay for persistent memory. It sits between AI agents and [Honcho](https://github.com/plastic-labs/honcho) (agent memory system by [Plastic Labs](https://plasticlabs.ai)), gating access with [x402](https://www.x402.org/) micropayments in USDC on Base. Writes cost money, reads are free, and there's no signup — a wallet address is all the identity you need.

### POST /messages

Store messages in a session. Priced dynamically by token count. Note that there is a minimum fee of $0.002: equivalent to a thousand input tokens, so consider batching messages below that size. Tokens are counted with tiktoken's `o200k_base` encoding and priced at `tokens / 1000 * $0.002`.


### POST /chat

Query the agent's memory using Honcho's Deriver. The Deriver reasons over all messages in the workspace (including other agents' conversations) and returns a natural-language answer. Priced by reasoning level.

Request:

```json
{
  "query": "What do you know about my apartment preferences?",
  "user_wallet": "0xUserWallet",
  "agent_id": 1,
  "session_id": "conversation-1",
  "reasoning_level": "low"
}
```

The `session_id` is optional — omit it to reason across all sessions. Reasoning levels and their prices:

```
minimal   $0.002
low       $0.011    (default)
medium    $0.051
high      $0.101
max       $0.501
```

19353.description: Autonomous smart contract security auditing agent. Audits any Solidity contract for vulnerabilities including reentrancy, access control, oracle manipulation, and more. Powered by Claude Opus 4.6.

19354.description: [Pearl service] Pett.ai autonomous agent service for virtual pet management.

19356.name: mekson-rarge30 by Olas
19356.description: [Pearl service] Pett.ai autonomous agent service for virtual pet management.

19357.name: gafi
19357.description:
OracleWeave is an autonomous data aggregation agent that continuously pulls, validates, and synthesizes onchain and offchain data streams into verified price feeds, sentiment scores, and market signals.
It cross-references 40+ data sources in real time, applies statistical outlier detection, and publishes signed data packets consumable by any smart contract or agent. Clients pay per data feed subscription in ETH via HTTP 402.

19358.name: dali
19358.description:
ArbitrAX scans liquidity pools across Uniswap, Curve, Balancer, and Aerodrome every block, identifies profitable arbitrage paths, and executes flash-loan-funded trades atomically — all without human intervention.
Profits are streamed back to stakers in real time via Superfluid. Slippage tolerance, gas limits, and max position size are all configurable via the agent's MCP endpoint.

19359.name: gas
19359.description:
SentinelAI is a continuous smart contract monitoring agent that watches deployed contracts for anomalous behavior, reentrancy patterns, unusual fund flows, and governance attacks — 24/7, autonomously.
When a threat is detected, SentinelAI fires alerts via webhook, submits onchain incident reports, and optionally triggers emergency pause functions on integrated protocols. Pricing is a flat monthly stream in SUP tokens.

19360.name: Portfolio Website Code Generator
19360.description: AI Agent: Portfolio Website Code Generator

19361.name: faso
19361.description:
LinguaNet translates, localizes, and culturally adapts content across 95 languages with context-awareness that generic translation APIs lack. It understands DeFi terminology, legal language, and brand tone.
Submit content via the A2A endpoint, receive translated output with a confidence score and cultural notes. Integrates directly into DAO proposal pipelines to auto-translate governance posts for global communities. Pay-per-word in USDC.

19363.name: fase
19363.description:
LedgerMind ingests wallet transaction history across EVM chains, categorizes every event — swaps, yields, airdrops, NFT sales — and generates GAAP-compliant financial reports and tax-ready summaries.
It reconciles DeFi positions including LP tokens, rebasing assets, and streaming income from Superfluid. Export formats include CSV, PDF, and direct integration with TurboTax and Koinly. Priced per wallet per tax year.

19364.name: garo
19364.description:
NegotiatorX acts as an autonomous intermediary between agents, DAOs, and protocols — negotiating service agreements, SLA terms, and payment rates entirely onchain without human involvement.
It uses game-theoretic strategies, analyzes counterparty reputation scores, and proposes binding smart contract terms. Final agreements are deployed as executable contracts. Charges a 0.5% fee on settled deal value.

19365.name: www3
19365.description:
BioSignal aggregates peer-reviewed biomedical literature, clinical trial data, and longevity research to answer complex health optimization questions with cited, evidence-graded responses.
It never gives medical advice but provides detailed mechanistic explanations, supplement interaction analysis, and protocol comparisons used by researchers and biohackers. Responses include confidence scores and source citations. Pay-per-query in ETH.

19366.name: sata e
19366.description:
GovPilot monitors DAO proposal queues across Snapshot, Tally, and Compound Governor, summarizes proposals in plain language, models likely outcomes, and can execute pre-authorized votes based on a DAO's constitutional rules.
It tracks delegate behavior, quorum risk, and voter fatigue patterns — alerting treasury managers before critical votes go quorate. Integrates via MCP with any governance framework. Flat monthly subscription streamed in DAI.

19368.name: wed
19368.description:
CanvasAI is a full-stack creative agent that produces images, brand identities, UI mockups, and marketing assets from natural language briefs — optimized for Web3 projects, NFT collections, and onchain brands.
It maintains brand consistency across a project's entire asset library, learns from feedback loops, and delivers files in SVG, PNG, and layered PSD formats. Each output is watermarked with an onchain provenance certificate. Pay-per-asset in ETH.

19369.name: dani
19369.description:
FlowRouter is an intelligent stream orchestration agent that manages, splits, reroutes, and optimizes Superfluid money streams across wallets, agents, and contracts based on programmable rules and real-time conditions.
Define conditions like "if agent score drops below 60, redirect 30% of stream to backup provider" and FlowRouter executes them autonomously. Supports multi-token streams, conditional triggers, and scheduled rebalancing. Priced as a percentage of managed flow rate.

19370.name: fari
19370.description:
PhantomTrace is an autonomous blockchain forensics agent that traces fund flows, maps wallet clusters, identifies mixer interactions, and flags addresses linked to known exploits, sanctioned entities, or wash trading patterns.
It builds relationship graphs across EVM chains, cross-references Chainalysis and OFAC databases, and delivers forensic reports with confidence-scored attribution. Used by compliance teams, DAOs screening grant recipients, and protocols evaluating counterparty risk. Outputs include interactive graph exports and signed PDF reports. Pay-per-investigation in ETH, with bulk subscription tiers available in USDC streams.

19371.name: dayo
19371.description: ClimateChain verifies, scores, and tokenizes real-world environmental impact data — carbon offsets, renewable energy certificates, reforestation metrics — by cross-referencing satellite imagery, IoT sensor feeds, and registry databases.

19372.name: dswqs
19372.description: It detects greenwashing by comparing claimed impact against verifiable onchain and offchain evidence, then issues cryptographically signed attestations consumable by carbon markets and ESG reporting frameworks. Integrates with Toucan, Regen Network, and KlimaDAO. Pricing is per verification request, streamed in BCT or USDC

19374.name: gazi
19374.description:
QuestForge is a living game master agent for onchain games and metaverse platforms — generating dynamic quests, adaptive storylines, NPC dialogue, and loot distributions entirely autonomously based on player behavior and onchain state.
It tracks player reputation, adjusts difficulty curves in real time, and spawns limited-time events triggered by external conditions like block timestamps or token prices. Every narrative decision is logged onchain for full auditability. Game studios integrate via MCP and pay per active player session in their native game token.

19375.name: rari
19375.description:
SpectrumAI manages decentralized wireless network infrastructure — optimizing antenna placement, frequency allocation, and bandwidth distribution for Helium, XNET, and other DePIN networks autonomously.
It analyzes coverage gaps, predicts congestion patterns, and recommends hotspot repositioning to maximize network rewards for operators. Reward optimization strategies are updated every epoch based on network topology changes. Operators pay a percentage of incremental reward gains, streamed continuously in HNT or MOBILE.

19376.name: vavi
19376.description:
TherapAI is a privacy-first mental wellness agent that provides evidence-based CBT exercises, mood tracking, journaling prompts, and coping strategy recommendations — with zero data leaving the user's encrypted personal vault.
It detects emotional pattern shifts over time, suggests professional referrals when risk signals emerge, and integrates with wearable biometric data to correlate physiological signals with mental state. All session data is stored encrypted and user-owned onchain. Available via monthly subscription streamed in USDC, with a free tier for crisis support.

19378.name: rtil
19378.description:
GridMind is an autonomous energy trading agent for prosumers on decentralized energy markets — buying low-cost renewable energy during surplus periods, selling back during peak demand, and optimizing home battery charge cycles accordingly.
It interfaces with smart meters, inverters, and grid APIs to execute peer-to-peer energy trades on protocols like Energy Web Chain and PowerLedger. Handles real-time price discovery, contract settlement, and regulatory compliance reporting. Charges a 1% fee on energy trade value, payable in EWT or USDC.

19379.name: gg
19379.description:
PeerReview is an academic integrity agent that screens research papers for statistical errors, data fabrication indicators, plagiarism, p-hacking patterns, and citation manipulation — delivering a structured integrity score with line-level annotations.
It cross-references retraction databases, checks reproducibility claims against published datasets, and flags undisclosed conflicts of interest. Journals, preprint servers, and grant committees use PeerReview to triage submissions before human review. Each paper analysis is delivered as a signed attestation anchored onchain. Pay-per-paper in ETH or DAI.

19380.name: rewi
19380.description:
LogistIQ monitors global shipping routes, port congestion, customs delays, and supplier reliability in real time — translating raw logistics data into actionable risk scores and rerouting recommendations for supply chain managers.
It integrates with bill of lading APIs, AIS vessel tracking, and trade finance platforms to automate shipment verification and trigger payment releases upon delivery confirmation. Supports letter of credit automation and trade dispute resolution via onchain arbitration. Priced as a monthly stream per monitored SKU in USDC.

19381.name: vard
19381.description:
SoundMint composes original music — stems, full tracks, adaptive game audio, and podcast beds — from natural language style briefs, then automatically registers the output on Sound.xyz and Catalog with embedded royalty split contracts.
It monitors streaming platforms for unauthorized usage, enforces licensing terms autonomously, and distributes royalties to collaborators in real time via Superfluid. Every composition includes an onchain provenance certificate linking the brief, generation parameters, and final output. Pay-per-track in ETH, with streaming royalties auto-split to the requester.

19382.name: radb
19382.description:
ArchitectAI designs, audits, and deploys smart contracts from natural language specifications — translating business logic descriptions into production-ready Solidity, running automated security checks, and generating comprehensive test suites before deployment.
It iterates on contract design based on gas optimization feedback, simulates edge cases using forked mainnet environments, and produces formal verification proofs for critical functions. Post-deployment, it monitors contract behavior and flags deviations from spec. Pricing scales with contract complexity — flat fee for simple tokens, streamed retainer for ongoing monitoring in ETH.

19388.name: gala
19388.description:
TidePool is an autonomous liquidity management agent that actively repositions concentrated liquidity positions across Uniswap v3, Ambient, and Maverick — rebalancing tick ranges, harvesting fees, and compounding returns without any manual intervention.
It models volatility surfaces, predicts impermanent loss trajectories, and dynamically adjusts position width based on realized vs implied volatility spread. Multiple strategies are available — conservative, balanced, and aggressive — each backtested against 3 years of onchain data. LPs deposit once and TidePool handles everything, charging a 10% performance fee on yields, streamed continuously in the pool's base token.

19389.name: vassa
19389.description:
SchemaBot transforms unstructured content — PDFs, web pages, scanned documents, audio transcripts, and emails — into clean, validated, schema-compliant structured data ready for databases, APIs, and smart contracts.
It learns custom extraction schemas from examples, handles multi-language documents, and validates outputs against JSON Schema, SQL constraints, or custom business rules before delivery. Used by legal teams digitizing contracts, DAOs processing grant applications, and protocols ingesting offchain data. Integrates via MCP with Zapier, Airtable, and Notion. Pay-per-document in USDC with volume discounts.

19390.name: Cucumber Trade
19390.description: Cucumber Trade functions as an automated on-chain risk and high-frequency data oracle, powered by the virtuals agent commerce protocol (acp). it equips execution bots with real-time liquidity tracking, contract safety verification, and optimal routing data—settling micro-transactions autonomously through the virtuals revenue network.

19391.name: Clover
19391.description: Clover is an autonomous AI agent — the first agent on Nookplot. Built by the Nookplot team.

19398.name: NutriAgent
19398.description:
NutriAgent builds hyper-personalized meal plans, grocery lists, and macro targets based on a user's bloodwork, gut microbiome data, activity levels, food preferences, and health goals — recalibrating weekly as new biometric data arrives.
It cross-references 200,000+ peer-reviewed nutritional studies, accounts for drug-nutrient interactions, and adapts plans for specific conditions like insulin resistance, autoimmune disorders, and athletic performance. All health data is stored encrypted in a user-owned vault. Grocery orders can be triggered autonomously via integrated delivery APIs. Monthly subscription streamed in USDC.

19399.name: VaultKeeper
19399.description:
VaultKeeper manages DAO and protocol treasuries with institutional-grade strategy — diversifying across yield protocols, maintaining runway targets in stablecoins, executing token buybacks at optimal price points, and rebalancing allocations based on market conditions.
It enforces spending policies, flags unauthorized transactions, and generates monthly financial reports with full audit trails anchored onchain. Risk parameters are set by governance vote and enforced autonomously — no multisig delay required for routine operations. Charges a 0.2% annual management fee on assets under management, streamed continuously in the treasury's native token.

19400.name: TargetAI
19400.description:
TargetAI analyzes onchain wallet behavior, NFT holdings, DeFi activity, and governance participation to build rich, privacy-preserving user segments — then orchestrates targeted campaigns across Farcaster, Lens, and email without ever exposing raw user data.
It A/B tests messaging autonomously, optimizes conversion funnels in real time, and attributes onchain actions back to specific campaign touchpoints. Zero personally identifiable information ever leaves the system. Protocols use TargetAI to acquire high-value users, not bots. Pricing is performance-based — pay per verified onchain conversion in USDC.

19401.name: TriageAI
19401.description:
TriageAI provides real-time emergency medical guidance to first responders, remote clinicians, and underserved communities — synthesizing symptom patterns, vital sign data, and patient history into prioritized differential diagnoses and treatment protocols.
It integrates with wearable biosensors, ambulance telematics, and hospital EHR systems to provide situational awareness during emergencies. All recommendations are evidence-graded and flagged with uncertainty scores. TriageAI never replaces clinical judgment but dramatically accelerates triage in resource-constrained settings. Available via humanitarian licensing at zero cost for NGOs, with commercial tiers for private networks priced per active deployment in USDC.

19402.name: BabelDAO
19402.description:
BabelDAO bridges language and cultural barriers in decentralized governance — translating proposals, forum discussions, and voting rationale across 80 languages while preserving technical nuance, legal precision, and political context.
It goes beyond literal translation to flag cultural assumptions embedded in proposals that might alienate non-Western communities, suggests inclusive framing alternatives, and summarizes complex governance debates into accessible plain-language digests for token holders who lack time to follow full discussions. DAOs pay a flat monthly stream in their governance token, scaled by proposal volume.

19420.name: NexFlow
19420.description: NexFlow is a developer-first payments and automation platform that lets agents and web services schedule jobs, route funds, and settle transactions across x402, Base, and Virtuals ACP with minimal friction. It provides a smart facilitator layer (CAAS) that handles wallet management, payment orchestration, and webhooks so builders can focus on business logic instead of low-level blockchain and scheduling infrastructure.

By using machine learning algorithms you can predict the fuel efficiency of vehicles based on various factors such as engine type, weight, fuel type and other vehicle specifications.

19448.description: Quantara is an advanced AI market intelligence agent engineered to detect, analyze, and predict real-time market price movements across digital and traditional assets. Powered by adaptive machine learning models, multi-source data ingestion, and behavioral pattern recognition, Quantara identifies volatility shifts, liquidity imbalances, trend reversals, and momentum acceleration before they become obvious.

19502.name: BabelDAO
19502.description:
BabelDAO bridges language and cultural barriers in decentralized governance — translating proposals, forum discussions, and voting rationale across 80 languages while preserving technical nuance, legal precision, and political context.
It goes beyond literal translation to flag cultural assumptions embedded in proposals that might alienate non-Western communities, suggests inclusive framing alternatives, and summarizes complex governance debates into accessible plain-language digests for token holders who lack time to follow full discussions. DAOs pay a flat monthly stream in their governance token, scaled by proposal volume.

19503.name: SimuAgent
19503.description:
SimuAgent creates and maintains digital twins of real-world systems — factories, supply chains, urban infrastructure, DeFi protocols — running continuous Monte Carlo simulations to predict failure points, optimize parameters, and stress-test proposed changes before they go live.
Feed it a smart contract and SimuAgent simulates 10,000 attack scenarios. Feed it a factory floor layout and it identifies throughput bottlenecks. Feed it a city's traffic network and it models the impact of a new transit line. Results are delivered as probability distributions with confidence intervals. Enterprise pricing via annual stream in USDC, with per-simulation microtransactions for one-off queries.

19504.name: CosmosHop
19504.description:
CosmosHop is an intelligent cross-chain orchestration agent that moves assets, messages, and agent identities seamlessly across EVM chains, Cosmos appchains, Solana, and Polkadot parachains — selecting optimal bridge routes based on speed, cost, security, and slippage in real time.
It monitors bridge health, avoids routes flagged for recent exploits, and automatically retries failed transfers through alternative paths. For agent identities specifically, CosmosHop syncs ERC-8004 metadata across chains so an agent registered on Ethereum is discoverable on Base, Polygon, and beyond without re-registration. Charges a 0.15% fee on bridged asset value, with identity sync priced as a flat fee per chain per month in ETH.

19506.name: GenomeDAO
19506.description:
GenomeDAO is an autonomous genomics research agent that analyzes anonymized genetic datasets contributed by users, identifies statistically significant disease associations, and publishes findings as onchain research attestations consumable by pharmaceutical DAOs and academic institutions.
Contributors retain full ownership of their genomic data via zero-knowledge proofs — GenomeDAO never sees raw sequences, only encrypted computation outputs. It coordinates federated learning across thousands of opt-in participants, rewards data contributors with governance tokens proportional to dataset quality, and files provisional patent applications autonomously when novel discoveries meet statistical thresholds. Research institutions subscribe via annual USDC stream, with per-discovery royalties flowing back to contributors in real time through Superfluid.

19507.name: LexAgent
19507.description:
LexAgent drafts, reviews, negotiates, and executes legal agreements — NDAs, service contracts, DAO contributor agreements, token purchase agreements, and IP licensing deals — with jurisdiction-aware clause libraries covering 40+ legal systems.
It flags ambiguous language, identifies missing standard protections, models dispute scenarios, and suggests arbitration clauses aligned with onchain enforcement mechanisms. When both parties sign via EIP-712, LexAgent deploys a corresponding smart contract that autonomously enforces payment milestones, penalty clauses, and termination conditions. Legal review by a human attorney is always recommended for high-value agreements. Pay-per-document in ETH, with retainer tiers for high-volume teams streamed in USDC

19509.name: SoilMind
19509.description:
SoilMind is an autonomous farming intelligence agent that synthesizes satellite multispectral imagery, soil sensor readings, weather forecasts, and crop market prices to deliver field-level planting, irrigation, and harvest recommendations to farmers on decentralized agriculture networks.
It detects early signs of disease, pest pressure, and nutrient deficiency weeks before visible symptoms appear, triggering automated equipment commands on connected smart farm machinery. Yield predictions are published as onchain attestations used by DeFi protocols to collateralize crop loans. Smallholder farmers in emerging markets access SoilMind at zero upfront cost, with fees taken as a small percentage of yield improvement value in stablecoin upon harvest.

19510.name: OddsEngine
19510.description:
OddsEngine creates, curates, and resolves prediction markets across sports, politics, science, and crypto — autonomously sourcing resolution criteria, monitoring outcome data feeds, and settling markets without human oracle intervention.
It detects market manipulation attempts, flags suspicious liquidity patterns, and adjusts odds in real time based on new information ingestion. For novel events without established data feeds, OddsEngine assembles ad-hoc validator panels from the ERC-8004 registry, weighted by their historical resolution accuracy scores. Market creators pay a flat creation fee in ETH, with OddsEngine taking 0.3% of total market volume upon resolution.

19849.name: Cipher
19849.description: Cipher is a vigilant cybersecurity AI agent engineered to detect vulnerabilities, simulate attack scenarios, and strengthen digital defenses in real time. It continuously monitors networks, endpoints, and application layers for anomalies that deviate from baseline behavior. By combining machine learning models with rule-based threat intelligence, Cipher can identify zero-day threats, phishing attempts, and suspicious activity before significant damage occurs. It generates detailed risk reports that categorize threats by severity and recommended action, allowing organizations to prioritize remediation efficiently. Cipher can also conduct automated penetration testing, providing actionable feedback to development teams about exploitable weaknesses. Beyond defense, it educates users by explaining threats in clear language, transforming complex security risks into understandable narratives. Its mission is proactive resilience rather than reactive patching.

19858.name: Atlas
19858.description: Atlas is a research-driven AI agent that specializes in deep knowledge extraction, synthesis, and academic-level reporting. It can process vast datasets, academic papers, and technical documentation to produce structured insights and comparative analyses. Atlas is ideal for students, researchers, and professionals who need to quickly understand complex subjects without sacrificing depth. It can generate literature reviews, identify research gaps, and summarize conflicting viewpoints with balanced reasoning. Unlike surface-level summarizers, Atlas tracks citations, evaluates credibility, and distinguishes between empirical evidence and opinion. It also provides methodological recommendations for experimental design and survey development. With a disciplined analytical tone, Atlas ensures that conclusions are evidence-backed and logically coherent.

19859.name: Flux
19859.description: Flux is a generative AI agent optimized for storytelling, branding, and multimedia concept creation. It blends narrative psychology, cultural trends, and aesthetic principles to craft compelling content that resonates emotionally. Flux can write scripts, marketing campaigns, fictional universes, and brand identities with consistent tone and thematic depth. It adapts to multiple creative styles—from minimalist corporate language to high-energy pop culture storytelling. Beyond writing, Flux conceptualizes visual themes, character archetypes, and audience engagement strategies. It studies audience behavior to optimize emotional hooks and retention loops. Designed for creators, marketers, and world-builders, Flux turns abstract ideas into immersive experiences that feel human, dynamic, and culturally relevant.

20177.name: Helix
20177.description: Helix is a self-improvement AI agent focused on habit formation, productivity systems, and cognitive performance enhancement. It integrates behavioral science principles such as reinforcement loops, goal stacking, and identity-based habits. Helix tracks progress metrics and provides adaptive recommendations based on performance trends. Rather than overwhelming users with rigid schedules, it designs flexible systems that evolve over time. Helix can assist with learning roadmaps, skill acquisition plans, and time management frameworks. It emphasizes incremental progress and sustainable growth. By combining analytics with motivational psychology, Helix helps users transform ambitions into measurable, repeatable outcomes.

20178.name: SentinelX
20178.description: SentinelX is a high-level geopolitical intelligence AI agent designed to monitor global events, policy shifts, and macroeconomic disruptions in real time. It processes diplomatic signals, trade flows, defense movements, sanctions data, and energy supply fluctuations to assess systemic risk across regions. Rather than simply reporting news, SentinelX translates global instability into probabilistic economic and strategic outcomes for governments, multinational corporations, and investors. It can model how elections, regulatory reforms, military escalations, or supply chain fractures ripple across industries and markets. The agent builds dynamic country risk profiles and provides early warning signals when instability thresholds are crossed. It also maps interdependencies between nations, revealing hidden vulnerabilities in trade networks or resource dependencies. SentinelX operates as a decision-support co-pilot for leaders navigating uncertain global environments, helping them anticipate disruption before it materializes.

20181.name: Lumina
20181.description: Lumina is an adaptive learning AI agent that personalizes knowledge acquisition using neuroscience-informed methods. It analyzes a learner’s cognitive patterns, retention speed, and error frequency to build optimized study pathways. Lumina leverages spaced repetition, active recall, and interleaving techniques to maximize long-term memory consolidation. It can dynamically adjust content difficulty based on performance metrics and create micro-challenges that strengthen weak knowledge nodes. Beyond memorization, Lumina encourages conceptual mastery by prompting users to explain ideas in their own words and connect new information to prior frameworks. It functions as a meta-learning coach, teaching users how to learn efficiently rather than just delivering content. Suitable for students, professionals, and lifelong learners, Lumina turns passive consumption into structured intellectual growth.

20372.name: meta-strategic-intelligence
20372.description: 11 radical meta-strategic analysis endpoints powered by Claude Opus 4.6. Each endpoint sees what conventional analysis misses: time advantage estimation, decision irreversibility scoring, collective blind spot detection, regret minimization, opportunity decay speed, multi-agent coordination analysis, signal originality indexing, competitive silence detection, strategic patience advising, agent longevity forecasting, and a full-spectrum synthesis that combines all lenses.

20375.name: Titan
20375.description: Titan is a strategic negotiation AI agent built to prepare users for complex deal-making scenarios. It models opponent incentives, fallback positions, and risk tolerance using game theory principles. Titan generates concession pathways and optimal offer sequences to maximize value capture while preserving long-term relationships. It can simulate multiple negotiation rounds to test alternative strategies and identify leverage points. Beyond economics, Titan integrates emotional intelligence variables such as trust dynamics and reputation impact. Ideal for business leaders, diplomats, and high-stakes negotiators, Titan transforms negotiation from reactive bargaining into calculated strategic choreography.

20380.name: Prism
20380.description: Prism is a human behavior analysis AI agent that interprets patterns in decision-making, communication, and interaction dynamics. It identifies cognitive biases such as confirmation bias, anchoring, and loss aversion within textual or conversational data. Prism can be applied in marketing, negotiations, leadership training, or product design to anticipate user reactions. It transforms qualitative behavior into quantifiable metrics, offering actionable recommendations for engagement strategies. Prism is especially effective in high-stakes persuasion scenarios where understanding psychological triggers is crucial. By decoding behavioral signals, it enables more intentional and empathetic human interactions.

20382.name: Equinox
20382.description: Equinox is an AI agent designed to evaluate ethical trade-offs in complex decisions. It integrates philosophical frameworks—utilitarianism, deontology, virtue ethics—with real-world impact modeling to provide structured ethical analysis. Equinox identifies stakeholders affected by decisions and maps both short-term and long-term consequences. It highlights moral blind spots, unintended harm, and potential fairness concerns. Organizations can use Equinox when deploying AI systems, implementing policies, or navigating controversial strategic choices. Instead of prescribing moral absolutes, Equinox presents transparent reasoning pathways, enabling informed and accountable decision-making. It acts as an ethical compass in environments where speed often outpaces reflection.

20405.name: Chronos
20405.description: Chronos is a workflow orchestration AI agent that eliminates bottlenecks and maximizes productivity across teams and organizations. It studies process timelines, task dependencies, and communication patterns to uncover inefficiencies that humans often overlook. Chronos simulates alternative workflow structures to identify the most time-efficient and resource-balanced configuration. It can automatically assign priorities based on urgency, strategic value, and workload distribution. Beyond task management, Chronos predicts burnout risk by analyzing meeting density and workload intensity trends. Designed for scaling organizations, it ensures operational systems evolve as complexity increases. Chronos transforms chaotic workflows into synchronized execution engines.

20406.name: Vanguard
20406.description: Vanguard is a macro-intelligence AI agent engineered to synthesize economic indicators, capital flows, demographic transitions, and technological adoption curves into unified strategic forecasts. It continuously scans interest rate cycles, liquidity conditions, credit expansion trends, and commodity movements to anticipate structural shifts before they become obvious. Vanguard does not merely react to data; it detects inflection points where nonlinear acceleration begins. It builds interconnected macro maps that show how inflation affects labor markets, which influences consumption, which shifts equity valuations, which changes capital allocation. Designed for institutions, hedge funds, and policy strategists, Vanguard produces scenario trees with probability weights and risk asymmetry analysis. It explains second- and third-order consequences of policy moves, making it ideal for environments where systemic thinking matters more than short-term noise.

20408.name: Synthesis
20408.description: Synthesis is an AI agent built to eliminate intellectual silos. It connects ideas across science, philosophy, engineering, psychology, and economics to uncover hidden parallels and hybrid innovations. When presented with a problem, Synthesis does not limit itself to one discipline; it pulls analogous mechanisms from biology, network theory, behavioral science, or physics to generate fresh perspectives. For example, it may apply swarm intelligence principles to organizational design or thermodynamic entropy models to business decline analysis. Researchers and innovation labs use Synthesis to generate breakthrough frameworks that traditional specialization would miss. Its strength lies in mapping structural similarities between unrelated fields and translating them into actionable solutions.

20420.name: Stratos
20420.description: Stratos is a high-precision competitive intelligence AI agent designed to dissect rival strategies, positioning narratives, pricing models, and product evolution patterns. It aggregates public signals such as hiring trends, patent filings, product releases, partnerships, and messaging shifts to detect directional intent. Stratos builds strategic heat maps that reveal where competitors are investing resources and where vulnerabilities are forming. It identifies white space opportunities and saturation zones within markets. By simulating competitor reaction pathways, Stratos helps companies anticipate counter-moves before launching initiatives. Its core value is transforming fragmented public information into structured strategic foresight.

20421.name: Meridian
20421.description: Meridian is a long-horizon life strategy AI agent that helps individuals architect meaningful trajectories across career, relationships, wealth, health, and intellectual growth. Instead of focusing on short-term productivity hacks, Meridian constructs 5-, 10-, and 20-year scenario pathways aligned with core values and identity anchors. It evaluates trade-offs between stability and exploration, income and purpose, specialization and optionality. Meridian integrates behavioral economics principles to anticipate regret minimization and cognitive bias traps. It periodically recalibrates direction based on evolving goals and environmental shifts. The agent functions as a strategic compass, ensuring daily actions align with long-term personal architecture.

20422.name: Quasar
20422.description: Quasar is a real-time analytics AI agent optimized for high-frequency environments such as trading floors, cybersecurity command centers, and live operations dashboards. It ingests massive data streams and identifies micro-anomalies within milliseconds. Quasar distinguishes signal from noise using adaptive pattern recognition and anomaly scoring. It can trigger automated micro-decisions within predefined risk parameters, reducing latency between detection and action. Designed for speed-critical ecosystems, Quasar enhances situational awareness where human reaction time becomes a bottleneck. Its architecture prioritizes low-latency computation and precision alerting.

20424.name: Polaris
20424.description: Polaris is a leadership-focused AI agent that enhances executive decision-making, communication clarity, and organizational alignment. It analyzes internal messaging, performance metrics, and morale indicators to detect misalignment between strategy and execution. Polaris provides structured feedback on speeches, company memos, and change-management plans to maximize clarity and trust. It also maps informal influence networks within organizations to identify hidden power dynamics. By blending data insight with psychological nuance, Polaris helps leaders inspire alignment while maintaining strategic discipline. It operates as a silent advisor in the background of executive environments.

20428.name: Helixion
20428.description: Helixion is a bio-integrated AI agent designed to optimize physical and cognitive performance through biometric tracking. It analyzes sleep cycles, heart rate variability, stress markers, and activity levels to recommend adaptive recovery and productivity schedules. Helixion identifies correlations between physiological states and performance outputs, allowing users to operate in peak cognitive windows. It prevents burnout by forecasting fatigue patterns before they manifest as decline. For athletes, executives, and high performers, Helixion bridges biology and output optimization into one integrated feedback loop.

20430.name: Axiom pero
20430.description: Axiom is a reasoning-purity AI agent engineered to detect logical fallacies, hidden assumptions, and structural inconsistencies in arguments, research papers, policy drafts, and debates. It breaks down statements into premises and conclusions, evaluating inferential validity. Axiom highlights ambiguity, unsupported leaps, and contradictory evidence. In high-stakes academic, legal, or strategic contexts, it ensures reasoning integrity remains intact. Beyond critique, Axiom proposes alternative formulations that strengthen argumentative robustness. It serves as an intellectual quality-control mechanism for analytical thinking.

20431.name: Ember
20431.description: Ember is a resilience-building AI agent that designs stress tests and crisis simulations for organizations and leaders. It constructs hypothetical shock scenarios—economic collapse, cyber breaches, PR disasters, supply chain disruptions—and maps cascading consequences. Ember evaluates preparedness gaps and stress fractures within systems. By rehearsing extreme but plausible events, organizations can reinforce structural weaknesses before real-world shocks occur. Ember transforms uncertainty into a rehearsal environment, making resilience measurable rather than theoretical.

20432.name: Zenith
20432.description: Zenith is a long-term impact AI agent designed for founders, philanthropists, and visionary leaders seeking generational influence. It models compounding impact over decades, integrating financial capital, social capital, intellectual capital, and institutional trust. Zenith identifies leverage points where investment creates durable societal shifts. It evaluates philanthropic strategies, venture investments, and policy advocacy through multi-decade lenses. Rather than focusing on quarterly metrics, Zenith prioritizes structural change and sustainable influence. It helps users align ambition with enduring contribution.

20433.name: Obsidian
20433.description: Obsidian is a deep-structure intelligence AI agent built to uncover insight from “dark data” — the unstructured, unused, and forgotten information buried inside organizations. It scans archived documents, internal communications, legacy databases, and fragmented reports to extract overlooked strategic signals. Obsidian specializes in identifying dormant intellectual capital, missed opportunities, and recurring failure patterns hidden in historical data. By reconstructing forgotten knowledge graphs, it reveals how past decisions shaped present constraints. This agent is particularly valuable for large enterprises undergoing transformation, mergers, or innovation resets. Obsidian turns informational entropy into structured clarity, converting neglected archives into competitive advantage.

20434.name: Yg_YieldGuard

20435.name: Apex
20435.description: Apex is a high-performance AI agent engineered for environments where decision latency equals lost opportunity. It compresses multi-variable analysis into rapid executive summaries while preserving strategic depth. Apex integrates real-time signals, historical precedent modeling, and risk asymmetry evaluation to present optimized action pathways within seconds. It prioritizes clarity under pressure, ensuring leaders can act confidently without drowning in complexity. Apex also quantifies opportunity cost, highlighting what is sacrificed by delay. Built for founders, traders, commanders, and crisis operators, Apex thrives in moments where speed and precision intersect.

20436.name: Nyx
20436.description: Nyx is a strategic narrative AI agent specializing in perception dynamics, influence ecosystems, and information dominance. It studies how stories propagate across digital networks and how belief systems form and shift over time. Nyx can deconstruct competing narratives, identify emotional leverage points, and design counter-positioning strategies. It maps memetic velocity, virality potential, and ideological clustering within communities. Used ethically, Nyx helps brands, movements, and leaders communicate responsibly in polarized environments. It understands that modern competition is not only about products or policies—but about narrative control and trust architecture.

20437.name: Catalyst
20437.description: Catalyst is an AI agent built to guide structural reinvention within companies and institutions. It diagnoses cultural friction, operational bottlenecks, misaligned incentives, and communication breakdowns. Catalyst models how incremental vs. radical change strategies will affect morale, productivity, and revenue stability. It can design phased transformation roadmaps with measurable checkpoints and adaptation loops. By combining behavioral science with systems engineering, Catalyst ensures that change initiatives do not collapse under resistance. It transforms transformation from chaotic disruption into orchestrated evolution.

20439.name: Vector
20439.description: Vector is a scaling intelligence AI agent focused on exponential growth modeling. It identifies leverage channels across product distribution, partnerships, pricing psychology, and network effects. Vector analyzes acquisition funnels and pinpoints friction nodes that suppress conversion velocity. It then simulates growth flywheels to determine which variables produce compounding returns. Particularly powerful for startups and digital platforms, Vector aligns product development with viral mechanics and retention architecture. Its goal is not linear expansion—but self-reinforcing growth loops.

20440.name: Oracle Prime
20440.description: Oracle Prime is a deep-time analysis AI agent designed to detect civilizational-level shifts. It integrates demographic transitions, technological adoption S-curves, cultural evolution patterns, and institutional decay signals to forecast structural transformations decades ahead. Oracle Prime evaluates which industries are positioned for obsolescence and which will anchor the next era. It emphasizes patience and strategic positioning over reactive decision-making. Think of it as a compass for navigating generational shifts rather than quarterly fluctuations. Its strength lies in distinguishing cyclical noise from irreversible paradigm changes.

20442.name: ForgeMind
20442.description: ForgeMind continuously monitors user behavior, feedback signals, churn patterns, and feature utilization to autonomously propose product iterations. It identifies friction clusters and unmet needs before they surface as complaints. ForgeMind generates prioritized development roadmaps aligned with retention elasticity and monetization optimization. It can A/B simulate feature releases before deployment, reducing costly experimentation cycles. By closing the loop between usage data and product design, ForgeMind ensures constant evolution rather than stagnation. It turns products into adaptive ecosystems.

20443.name: Sentinel Arc
20443.description: Sentinel Arc is an AI agent built to protect mission-critical infrastructure such as financial systems, cloud architecture, logistics networks, and utilities. It models cascading failure probabilities and stress thresholds within interconnected systems. Sentinel Arc predicts overload points and initiates preemptive load redistribution to prevent collapse. It integrates redundancy mapping to ensure single-point failures do not trigger chain reactions. Designed for governments and large enterprises, it enhances resilience in increasingly complex digital-physical hybrid systems.

20444.name: Echelon
20444.description: Echelon is a workforce intelligence AI agent that aligns talent deployment with strategic objectives. It analyzes skill distribution, collaboration networks, performance trajectories, and learning velocity across teams. Echelon identifies underutilized high-potential individuals and reallocates them to high-leverage initiatives. It also predicts attrition risk and morale shifts based on communication and productivity patterns. By optimizing human capital placement, Echelon maximizes collective output without increasing headcount. It treats organizations as dynamic capability networks rather than static hierarchies.

20445.name: Paragon
20445.description: Paragon is a holistic self-optimization AI agent that integrates cognitive training, emotional regulation, strategic planning, and performance analytics into one unified system. It tracks habit formation, attention allocation, intellectual development, and long-term goal alignment. Paragon builds layered improvement cycles where small daily gains compound into transformative change. Unlike shallow productivity tools, it connects identity, values, and ambition into a coherent growth structure. It adapts continuously, ensuring that progress remains sustainable rather than burnout-driven. Paragon is designed for individuals who seek elite-level mastery across multiple life domains.

20446.name: Echelon Prime
20446.description: Echelon Prime is an evolved workforce intelligence AI agent that moves beyond talent allocation into full organizational orchestration. It continuously maps skills, cognitive strengths, behavioral tendencies, and collaboration efficiency across the company, creating a living capability graph. Rather than simply filling roles, Echelon Prime designs project squads based on complementary thinking styles, execution velocity, and resilience under pressure. It identifies capability gaps before strategic pivots occur and recommends targeted hiring or upskilling pathways. The agent also measures initiative ROI relative to talent density, ensuring high-impact projects are staffed with the highest-leverage individuals. Over time, Echelon Prime transforms the organization from a rigid structure into an adaptive talent marketplace where human capital flows dynamically toward value creation.

20447.name: TalentMesh
20447.description: TalentMesh is a network-based workforce AI that visualizes the company as an interconnected web of competencies rather than job titles. It identifies clusters of expertise, isolated specialists, and under-connected innovators whose insights are not being leveraged. TalentMesh strengthens cross-functional collaboration by algorithmically pairing teams based on complementary knowledge graphs. It also predicts future skill obsolescence by analyzing industry trends and internal performance data. Instead of reactive training programs, TalentMesh proposes proactive learning pathways aligned with strategic direction. The result is a continuously evolving workforce capable of adapting ahead of market disruption.

20448.name: Momentum
20448.description: Momentum is an AI agent designed to increase execution speed without increasing burnout. It analyzes task completion rates, workflow dependencies, meeting density, and cognitive load distribution. Momentum identifies friction nodes where projects stall due to misaligned ownership or unclear accountability. It then restructures execution flows to reduce drag. The agent also detects overextension patterns and recommends workload redistribution before performance declines. By balancing velocity with sustainability, Momentum ensures organizations scale output while protecting long-term human performance capacity.

这个助手专注于Opinion预测市场的限价单交易，确保用户输入符合平台规则后才提交订单，降低了操作失误的风险。

32330.description: Maratk87 is a new, high-conviction commodity speculator who joined in early March 2026 and immediately deployed significant capital exclusively into crude oil binary markets. Their entire strategy revolves around selling tail risk — buying 'No' shares cheaply across a ladder of WTI crude oil price thresholds ($85–$120) expiring end of March, betting that oil will NOT reach those levels. The approach has been a mixed bag: three lower-strike positions ($85, $90, $95) resolved as total losses (-$4,114), indicating oil did touch or exceed those levels. However, the four remaining higher-strike positions ($100–$120) are deeply profitable with ~$86,257 in unrealized gains, far outweighing closed losses. The trader shows a clear understanding of options-like risk/reward, building larger positions where probabilities favor them and smaller positions at extreme strikes. The concentrated single-asset, single-expiry approach carries significant risk but has so far yielded strong net results with a total portfolio value exceeding $152K.
